scope: GitHub infrastructure outcomes only; not a measurement artifact

check.name: Same binary ABBA then separate native thread samples

annotation.observer: audit_scope through the visible GitHub job annotations panel
annotation.text: The hosted runner lost communication with the server. Anything in your workflow that terminates the runner process, starves it for CPU/Memory, or blocks its network access can cause this error.

limitations: The job ended while its measurement step remained marked in progress; its artifact-upload step never ran.
No recoverable artifact proves how many ABBA processes or thread traces ran before communication was lost.
The annotation lists possible causes; it does not establish CPU, memory, or network as the specific cause.
